comment: The custom instructions a fresh install starts with (core/src/instructions.rs). The prompt carries them as [Writer's notes: global, then the app's note], at most 400 characters. Groups give apps a shared note: {"kind": "email", "note": "...", "apps": [bundle IDs]}. None ship: on the corpus, per-app style notes helped 3 of 11 documents and hurt 5 (docs/MEASUREMENTS.md). Measure any change with ft-replay --default-instructions.
global: Natural, clear writing that matches the tone of the text so far, with correct spelling and grammar.
